sandbachFocus: Sandbach United maintained their position at the summit with a dominant 3-0 home victory over Shawbury United on Saturday 21 November. The win extended their excellent recent form, building on successive wins and cementing their 1st place finish with 37 points from 17 games. This result keeps Sandbach three points clear of second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals continue their remarkable streak, now unbeaten in their last six consecutive league matches—all victories—keeping them second with 34 points. Stafford Town secured a thrilling 4-2 away win against Darlaston Town in a cup fixture (not a league match), and are scheduled to face Market Drayton Town at home on Saturday 21 November in their league fixture. AFC Bridgnorth suffered a 3-1 defeat away at Shawbury United on Tuesday 17 November but remain third in the league. The Tuesday 17 November fixture between New Mills and Crewe was postponed due to a waterlogged pitch at New Mills; both clubs have rescheduled opportunities this Saturday and beyond. Alsager Town, currently struggling in 19th place, faced New Mills at home on Saturday 21 November after a pitch inspection. Barnton played a cup fixture in the Macron Cup (3rd Round) against FC Isle of Man on Saturday 21 November, while their upcoming league fixture is a home game against Alsager Town on Tuesday 24 November. Crewe face Cheadle Heath Nomads at home on Saturday 21 November in their league fixture. Foley Meir travel to Dawley Town on Saturday 21 November, with Dawley looking to build on a recent home win. Wednesfield Community are away at AFC Bridgnorth on Saturday 21 November. Widnes Town are at home to Brereton Social on Saturday 21 November.
